flash_691637.description:
Following a request from Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday evening ordered the immediate dispatch of an aid delegation to Colombia following the earthquake disaster that struck the country.

"The State of Israel shares in the grief of the families of those killed in the disaster and will provide full assistance to the Republic of Colombia," said the Prime Minister's Office.

flash_691636.description: Two aviators dead after an AH-64 Apache helicopter from Fort Hood crashes in Salado, Texas, sparking a large wildfire that triggered local evacuations.

flash_691638.description: The US criticizes Defense Minister Katz’s call for a long-term presence in southern Lebanon, urging adherence to the agreed security framework.

flash_691640.description: The Gvura Forum issues an urgent demand to the Prime Minister and ministers to immediately resume offensive strikes in the Gaza Strip, warning against putting IDF troops at risk.

flash_691639.description:
The family of Mali and Liel Yahalomi, the Israeli mother and daughter missing in Vienna, is sharply criticizing recent publications and briefings by police and investigative officials.

In an official statement, the family clarified: "We view with utmost severity the briefings circulated in recent hours, which create the public impression that a conclusion has already been established regarding the circumstances of Mali and Liel's disappearance. The family possesses information that fundamentally contradicts several of the claims raised in these reports."

According to the family, the information provided to them by the police shows no unusual activity on the bank accounts of either woman: "We unequivocally clarify that at this stage, there is no basis for ruling out the possibility of a nationalistically motivated terrorist incident."

flash_691645.description: According to Reuters, Israel and Lebanon have agreed on four nations - Britain, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia - as potential foreign observers to verify Hezbollah's disarmament.

flash_691644.description: Speaking on Newsmax, US Ambassador Mike Huckabee praises Secret Service agents and Mossad intelligence for thwarting Iranian threats against President Trump.

flash_691642.description: Likud issues sharp response to Yisrael Beytenu chairman after he claimed that dozens of Nukhba terrorists practiced a raid on an Israeli community and that political leadership prevented the IDF from taking action.

flash_691641.description: The German government has approved measures granting intelligence services new authority to hack digital communications and disrupt the activities of hostile actors abroad.

flash_691650.description: Jewish investors Joshua Kushner and Bob Iger agree to acquire the LA Lakers for a record $12.5 billion, subject to NBA approval.

flash_691649.description: Terror group Hamas announces plans to participate in upcoming PA legislative elections, opposing pre-conditions and aiming to challenge Fatah's political control.

flash_691647.description: According to The Washington Post, US Intelligence officials doubted Israeli reports of an Iranian plot against Trump, but a covert plane swap was executed out of extra caution.

flash_691643.description:
The death toll from the powerful earthquake that struck Colombia has risen to 265.

Additionally, at least 496 people remain listed as missing as search and rescue operations continue.

flash_691653.description: Judea and Samaria District Police arrest nine Palestinian Arabs after dozens attack Jews at Mikneh Avraham Farm.

flash_691652.description:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Hossein Taeb, who was appointed commander of the Basij organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). During the meeting, Pezeshkian congratulated Taeb on his appointment.

Taeb, who previously served as head of the IRGC's Intelligence Organization and as commander of the Basij during the suppression of the 2009 protests, was appointed to the position by order of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, following the death of the previous commander, Gholam-Reza Soleimani.

flash_691648.description: Turkish President Erdogan meets PA chairman Mahmoud Abbas in Ankara, accusing Israel of exploiting regional turmoil and pledging support for Palestinian statehood.

flash_691646.description: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty after a grand jury indicts him on murder charges for the fatal stabbing of his parents, Rob and Michele Singer Reiner.

flash_691659.description: Burgas selected as host city for Eurovision 2027

flash_691657.description: "Your heart was too big for this world."

flash_691651.description:
The family of Mali and Liel Yahalomi has pushed back against police briefings regarding their disappearance, saying there is no evidence to rule out a nationalistically motivated terror attack.

The family said they provided Lahav 433 investigators with all information in their possession and warned that some reports about the case contradict information they have received.

flash_691665.description:
CEO of the Bank of Jerusalem, Yair Kaplan, where Mali worked, addressed employees in a letter regarding her disappearance. According to him, "Other than the fact that she is a bank employee, no connection has been found between the incident and the bank."

Kaplan emphasized that a gag order has been imposed on the incident and that it is forbidden to share information about the case.

Read More

flash_691656.description: 57% of secular Israelis support religious presence in the public realm, provided it is not forced. Two-thirds of young Israelis view Judaism in a positive light.

flash_691654.description: Ziv survived the Re'im shelter attack while Eliya spent 505 days in Gaza. Now, ahead of their wedding, a fellow victim's father will write their marriage contract.

flash_691666.description: Welcomed by singing worshippers, Tal Dardik returned to the Temple Mount after his release from detention and received blessings for himself, his wife, and their newborn son.

flash_691663.description:
IDF: Yesterday (Wednesday), IDF troops operating in the southern Gaza Strip identified a terrorist who crossed the Yellow Line and approached the troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat to them.

Following the identification, the troops responded with fire in order to respond to the threat. A hit was identified.

IDF troops under the Southern Command remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue to operate to remove any immediate threat.

flash_691661.description: The Anti-Defamation League holds confidential briefing for students and staff, to expose how hatred toward Jews and Israelis has seeped into academic networks.

flash_691658.description: Calls received by MK Son Har-Melech indicate that candidates destined for service in combat units were informed only on their draft day that the ISA opposes their serving in the army.

flash_691684.description: Commander of the Gaza District Police, Jamal Mahmoud Abu Kamil, was eliminated in an IDF strike on his car. Earlier in the day, the IDF eliminated a Hamas commander in Khan Yunis.

flash_691689.description: Israel will get relief from the August heat as temperatures are expected to drop over the weekend, with a chance of rainfall in parts of the country.

flash_691688.description: The word "settlers" is often used as a pejorative, but a study of the Torah, the Sages, and the words of our Rabbis reveals the central place of "inheritance" in the Jewish story.

flash_691687.description:
Yesterday (Wednesday), during an operation in the area of Mrah el Aaqbe, IDF soldiers of the 55th Brigade located and dismantled a booby-trapped structure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organization.

Additionally, the soldiers located RPG rockets and additional weapons.

"The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians and its soldiers, and will continue to operate in order to remove threats in accordance with the ceasefire agreement," the military said.

flash_691683.description: The fictional "Gazan children starving" scenario was never real. It was meant to destroy empathy for Jewish children - schoolchildren, toddlers, and babies. Opinion.

flash_691679.description: The IDF conducted an airstrike in the Khan Yunis area targeting the commander of a Hamas military wing company, who, according to the military, planned to carry out terror attacks against troops operating in the Gaza Strip. The strike was conducted to remove the threat.

flash_691698.description: Giving enemies, who are sworn to our destruction, parts of Israel is equally emphatically not the Jewish way of relating to them.

flash_691707.description:

"You chose to represent draft evaders and forgot those who serve - the serving public will not forget this," the party stated.

flash_691715.description: Woman in her 20s forcibly taken in a vehicle by her family members from the Dan region. A joint operation by police and IDF forces leads to her rescue in Hebron.

flash_691721.description: "Judges and officers you shall appoint at all your gates": The gates of consciousness.

flash_691720.description:
A Maariv poll published on Friday morning shows the coalition bloc weakening by one seat this week, standing at just 48 seats. The coalition's decline is a direct result of Likud losing one seat, dropping to 21.

Seat breakdown in the poll: Yashar (led by Eisenkot) 23, Likud 21, Together (led by Bennett) 14, Yisrael Beytenu 10, The Democrats 10, Otzma Yehudit 8, United Torah Judaism 8, Shas 7, Hadash-Ta'al 6, Ra'am 5, Religious Zionist party 4, Zionist Home (led by Tropper and Hendel) 4.

The Zionist opposition bloc reaches 57 seats, and together with Chili Tropper and Yoaz Hendel could form a majority of 61 seats. The Arab parties account for an additional 11 seats.

flash_691718.description: According to haredi analyst Yaakov Rivlin, United Torah Judaism is expected to break up into two independent factions following the elections and conduct separate coalition negotiations.

flash_691716.description: During his performance at the Sultan's Pool, Amedi addresses Simcha and Leah Goldin in the audience, reflecting on their bond over the years and thanking them for their dedicated service to the nation.

flash_691713.description:
A motorcyclist in his 40s was seriously injured in a collision with a vehicle in Holon.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital.

flash_691711.description:
Saudi Crown Prince and de facto ruler, Prince Mohammed bin Salman, met with the commander of the United States Central Command (CENTCOM), Admiral Brad Cooper, the Saudi state news agency reported.

According to the report, the two discussed bolstering military and defense cooperation between Washington and Riyadh, as well as reviewing joint efforts to curb escalation and maintain regional stability and security in the Middle East.

flash_691722.description: The month-long course returns with lessons from combat, training on specialized weapons, and new tools to help elite units counter the growing drone threat.

flash_691719.description: Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas declares that his party aims to be at the center of decision-making following the elections: "No one will dictate our role in politics."

flash_691717.description: A new Direct Polls survey projects 30 Knesset seats for Likud and 23 for Gadi Eisenkot’s slate. The governing coalition reaches 59 seats, while the center-left bloc stands at 50.

flash_691735.description: After receiving a report of gunfire on a vehicle, police raid complex and find M-16 assault rifle hiding in preschool sandbox.

The ministry stressed that, at this time, no confirmed case of Ebola has been diagnosed in Israel.

According to the authority, an unusually large backlog of approximately 90 flights accumulated within three hours, while around 90,000 passengers are expected to pass through the airport today.

More than 50 kilograms of drugs, estimated to be worth millions of shekels, were discovered yesterday during searches along Israel’s eastern border in the Jordan Valley area.

According to the IDF, the drugs were found in sacks by troops from the Lions of the Jordan Battalion and trackers from the Jordan Valley and Emekim Brigade. They were handed over to police for further investigation.

In recent months, security forces have foiled smuggling attempts involving more than 200 kilograms of drugs in the area.

The family is asking the public to pray for his recovery, saying that since the death of his grandson, he has struggled to return to his daily routine and has barely eaten.
